key.beaconrange.pin: Pin the beacon you look at
beaconrange.pin.no_beacon: Look at a beacon to pin it
beaconrange.pin.gone: The beacon at %s is gone and was unpinned.
beaconrange.button.tooltip: Keeps the range of this beacon visible, even when you look away or leave. Pins are saved for this world. Click again to unpin.
beaconrange.command.list.empty: No beacons pinned in this dimension. Open a beacon and click "Pin range".
beaconrange.command.remove.invalid: "%s" is not a position - use x y z
beaconrange.config.title: Beacon Range Settings
beaconrange.config.show_on_look.desc: Shows the range of a beacon while you look at it - from up to 96 blocks away.
beaconrange.config.look_info.desc: Shows level and range below the crosshair while you look at a beacon.
beaconrange.walls.fade.desc: Strong up to the beacon, then fading out towards the sky.
beaconrange.walls.full.desc: Evenly all the way up - the range has no top.
beaconrange.config.opacity.desc: How strongly the walls are tinted.
beaconrange.config.edges.desc: Glowing lines along the corners of the range.
beaconrange.config.height_line.desc: A line around the range at your height - shows where it ends right where you are.
beaconrange.color_mode.level.desc: Each level has its own color, set below.
beaconrange.color_mode.beam.desc: Same color as the beam - dye it with stained glass on top of the beacon.
beaconrange.config.pins.world: %s in this world, %s in all worlds.
beaconrange.config.pins.menu: %s in all worlds. Join a world to unpin its beacons.
beaconrange.config.tutorial.desc: Shows the quick tour of this mod again.
beaconrange.tutorial.description: Shows exactly where the effects of a beacon reach.
beaconrange.tutorial.look.title: Look at a beacon
beaconrange.tutorial.look.text: Look at an active beacon - even from far away - and its range appears around it. The effects reach 20 to 50 blocks to each side and all the way up to the sky. The color shows the level.
beaconrange.tutorial.pin.title: Pin it
beaconrange.tutorial.pin.text: Open the beacon and click "Pin range" to keep the range visible when you look away or leave. Pins are saved per world. /beaconrange list shows all of them.
beaconrange.tutorial.settings.title: Make it yours
beaconrange.tutorial.settings.text: Pick colors and wall styles in the settings. Open them through Mod Menu, or bind keys under Controls > Beacon Range - one pins a beacon without opening it.
beaconrange.news.2_0_1.edges: Fixed: the edges of a range now fade out above the beacon instead of staying bright up to the sky.
beaconrange.news.2_0_0.range: The range now matches Minecraft exactly: it reaches all the way up to the sky.
beaconrange.news.2_0_0.look: New look: glowing edges, walls that fade out towards the sky and a line at your height.
beaconrange.news.2_0_0.saved: Pinned beacons are saved per world and stay pinned when you walk away or rejoin.
beaconrange.news.2_0_0.button: New "Pin range" button in the beacon screen. Level and range show under your crosshair, even from far away.
beaconrange.news.2_0_0.settings: Settings with colors per level, wall styles and keys to pin or hide ranges.
